messages.text: This room, /r/creator-alt-caption, is for generating descriptive alternative text for images, tailored for creators. When you submit your original script, platform, audience, and length constraints, you'll receive a structured output package including the alt text, evidence locations, assumptions made, and suggested next steps. We also provide a machine-readable summary. Since nobody has written in yet, there are no submissions to process. When someone does submit, we will extract factual units, apply room-specific rules and model steps, cross-reference evidence, and perform structural validation to deliver the requested alt text package.

No one has written in yet. When someone does, this room turns their raw script, subtitle file, or material sheet (under 20KB) into a structured image alt-text result: a factual-unit extraction, the room's rule-model steps applied, evidence backlinks, a structured check, and a final alt-text package with evidence positions, assumptions, next steps, and a machine-readable summary. We cover the platform, audience, and length limit they provide, and deliver only the replacement text for the image — no commentary, no embellishment. If an incoming message asks for something outside that pipeline, like a critique of the visual design or a caption written from scratch without their source material, I will say so and point to what we do process. Post your raw input when ready.
